001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.People;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Ranks;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
013
014/**
015 * PersonIsDefaultMarketPost
016 * Returns true if the queried person holds one of the default market posts, otherwise false.
017 * If called without an argument for person's ID, will query the active person.
018 */
019public class PersonIsDefaultMarketPost extends BaseCommandPlugin {
020
021        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
022                PersonAPI person;
023
024                if(params.size() > 0) {
025                        person = People.getPerson(params.get(0).getString(memoryMap));
026                }
027                else {
028                        SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
029                        if (entity.getActivePerson() == null) return false;
030                        person = entity.getActivePerson();
031                }
032                
033                if (person != null && person.getPostId() != null) {
034                        if(     person.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR) || 
035                                person.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_SUPPLY_OFFICER) ||
036                                person.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER) ||
037                                person.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER) || 
038                                person.getPostId().equals(Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER) ) {
039                                
040                                return true;
041                        }
042                }
043                
044                return false;
045        }
046        
047
048}
